agent.title: Research Agent
agent.subtitle: Launch research runs, follow each step's status, and keep recurring objectives on schedule.
agent.no_session_hint: Pick a session on the left, or submit a new objective below.
agent.welcome_hint: Describe a research objective — I will plan steps, call tools, and log an auditable trail.
agent.context_hint: The rule-based planner needs structured context (for example {"ticker": "AAPL"}) to plan an objective. Leave it empty for objectives it can parse on its own.
agent.chip_topic_prefill: Compare Q1 vs Q2 R&D investment using the indexed documents
agent.run_archived_detail: The backend no longer has a readable status for this run. It may have restarted, the run id may be stale, or access ownership may have changed. The last known state is shown above.
agent.sessions_empty_hint: Submit an objective to start one.
agent.schedules_note: Schedules live in process memory and may be lost when the service restarts.
agent.schedules_empty_hint: Register a recurring objective to run on a cron schedule.
agent.form_objective_placeholder: What should run on this schedule?
agent.plan_not_exposed: The orchestrator's plan internals (arguments, dependencies, outputs) are not exposed by the current research REST API
agent.conclusion_not_exposed: The final conclusion and evidence are computed by the orchestrator but not returned by the current REST API
agent.limits_more: What the research REST API returns
agent.limits_detail: This page shows only what the API returns: objective, owner, phase, error and per-step status. Plan arguments, step dependencies, step outputs, the final conclusion and evidence never leave the orchestrator.
agent.conclusion_unavailable: No final conclusion was returned for this run.

trace.matrix_scope_note: This stream covers matrix cell execution only.
